title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
title_zh: 「真」与「假」加起来等于一吗？LLM 智能体观点模拟中的补集一致性

paragraphs.en: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent’s position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p p with 1 − p 1-p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen’s paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs.
paragraphs.zh: 在大语言模型智能体观点模拟中，每个智能体在看到自己之前报告的概率以及其邻居所报告的概率之后，报告某个论断为真的概率，而这个数字将成为它在下一轮中的状态。 如果这个数字描述的是智能体的立场而非它所看到的句子，那么将该论断改写为其补命题，并把每个概率 p 替换为 1 − p，应当返回互补的答案，因此这两次报告之和应当等于一。 我们用三个小型开放模型进行测试：Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 和 Gemma-3-4B。 在从运行中的网络模拟中提取的 2,304 个智能体状态上，Qwen 的配对报告之和平均为 1.18，而在来自 AVeriTeC 的 48 条真实事实核查论断上，其总和同样超过一。 一个包含 24 个世界、每个世界恰有两种可能结果的受控基准测试表明，三个模型都存在同样的失败。 这种偏差比同义改写所产生的变化大两到十倍，并且在重复采样、不同的同伴群体规模和报告强度下持续存在。 当这些报告被反馈到两个从互补状态出发的群体中时，两个群体不再保持镜像关系：对于每个模型，五轮之后它们的分歧均为正值。 将每个答案与其配对答案的补值取平均，可以在构造上恢复一致性，并降低在两种表述下平均的 Brier 损失，但在最后一轮，它在三个模型中仅对一个模型优于两种原始表述中较好的那一个。 在同一模型上进行的调度-目标实验给出了一个小而稳定的交互效应，因为此类扫描会保持论断的措辞不变。 因此，在把模拟得到的概率当作信念来解读之前，需要先对措辞变换下的一致性进行专门的检验。

paragraphs.en: A language-model agent can report the probability of a claim after observing its current probability, its neighbors’ reports, and source evidence. In a numerical agent simulation, that answer becomes the agent’s next state and enters its neighbors’ subsequent requests. A report therefore serves two roles: it measures the current response and helps determine the information available in the next round. Conclusions about evidence delivery and collective behavior depend on this feedback process.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体可以在观察到其当前概率、邻居的报告以及来源证据之后，报告某个断言的概率。 在数值化智能体仿真中，该回答会成为智能体的下一个状态，并进入其邻居的后续请求。 因此，报告具有双重作用：它既度量当前的响应，又有助于确定下一轮可用的信息。 关于证据传递和集体行为的结论都依赖于这一反馈过程。

paragraphs.en: Varying graphs, seeds, initial conditions, and update schedules tests how collective outcomes depend on simulation design. A separate question concerns the local update itself: does it assign compatible probabilities to equivalent descriptions of the same information? An intervention can look robust across schedules while the agents assign incompatible probabilities to complementary descriptions, so robustness to design choices leaves the question open.
paragraphs.zh: 变换图结构、随机种子、初始条件和更新节奏，可以检验集体结果如何依赖于仿真设计。 另一个问题涉及局部更新本身：对于同一信息的不同等价描述，它是否会给出相容的概率？ 即使干预在不同更新节奏下看似稳健，智能体仍可能对互补的描述赋予不相容的概率，因此对设计选择的稳健性并不能回答这一问题。

paragraphs.en: We connect the local criterion to simulation outcomes through three levels of evidence. A network experiment compares degree-targeted and random evidence delivery under three update schedules. Paired probes then examine agent states encountered in that experiment and negated versions of real fact-checking claims. A controlled benchmark defines exact binary alternatives and transforms the complete request, separating complement discrepancies from paraphrase sensitivity, explicit negation, and variation across repeated samples.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个层级的证据将局部判据与仿真结果联系起来。 一项网络实验在三种更新调度下比较了基于度数的证据投放与随机证据投放。 随后，配对探针检查该实验中遇到的智能体状态，以及真实事实核查主张的否定版本。 一个受控基准定义了精确的二元备选项并转换完整请求，从而将补全差异与改写敏感性、显式否定以及重复采样间的变异区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The controlled benchmark also makes feedback directly testable. Two populations start from complementary states, receive the same evidence, and evolve with the same model. Mapping their reports to common coordinates shows whether the paths remain equivalent. Separate repaired populations test whether enforcing consistency improves factual loss once the repair itself changes future requests. Varying the number of peers and the strength of their reports shows how these observations depend on the social information the agent sees.
paragraphs.zh: 该受控基准还使反馈可以直接检验。 两个种群从互补状态出发，接收相同的证据，并以相同的模型演化。 将它们的报告映射到共同坐标，可以显示这些路径是否保持等价。 独立的修复种群检验的是：一旦修复本身改变了未来的请求，强制一致性是否能改善事实损失。 通过改变同伴数量及其报告的强度，可以显示这些观察结果如何依赖于智能体所看到的社交信息。

paragraphs.en: We make three contributions. First, we define a complement-consistency test for the update step of an LLM-agent simulation and show that three small open models fail it on states from a running simulation, on real fact-checking claims, and on a controlled benchmark in which every world has exactly two outcomes. Second, we show that the failure exceeds sensitivity to a same-meaning paraphrase, persists under repeated sampling and across peer counts and report strengths, and carries into later rounds when reports are fed back into the simulation. Third, we evaluate averaging each report with the complement of its paired report, which restores consistency by construction, and show that its effect on factual loss under feedback depends on the model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们做出三项贡献。 首先，我们为LLM智能体模拟的更新步骤定义了一种补集一致性测试，并表明三个小型开源模型在来自运行中模拟的状态、真实事实核查声明，以及每个世界恰好有两种结果的受控基准上都无法通过该测试。 其次，我们表明这种失败超出了对同义改写的敏感性，在重复采样、不同同伴数量和不同报告强度下持续存在，并且当报告被反馈回模拟时会延续到后续轮次。 第三，我们评估了将每份报告与其配对报告的补集进行平均的方法，该方法在构造上恢复一致性，并表明在反馈条件下其对事实损失的影响取决于具体模型。

sents.en: We make three contributions.
sents.zh: 我们做出三项贡献。

paragraphs.en: Betz and Richardson (2023) study probabilistic coherence and evidence integration in language models. Zhu and Griffiths (2024) examine probability identities and repeated numerical judgments. Logical consistency also supplies evaluation signals when ground truth is difficult to assess ( Fluri et al. 2023 ) . These studies motivate checking elicited numbers against relationships implied by the questions.

paragraphs.en: Meaning-preserving changes to prompt wording and format can move model outputs by large margins ( Sclar et al. 2024 ) , and models respond to acquiescence-style manipulations of survey items differently from people ( Tjuatja et al. 2024 ) . Our test differs in that one transformation changes the claim, the agent’s probability and every peer report together, so the correct response is fixed by arithmetic.

paragraphs.en: The real-claim study uses 48 screened AVeriTeC development claims, balanced between Supported and Refuted, from 25 fact-checking organizations ( Schlichtkrull et al. 2023 ) . We selected standalone claims with linked textual evidence, at most three per organization, before collecting any model responses. Each claim crosses two initial positions, five opposition levels in steps of 25 % 25\% , absent/visible source evidence, original/negated wording, private/public audience, and two mirrored peer orders. Four peers report 0.2 0.2 or 0.8 0.8 . The design contains 7,680 response records; the two peer-order reports are averaged before nonlinear outcomes are computed, leaving 3,840 observations and 1,920 complement pairs. Their absolute discrepancy is therefore the absolute discrepancy of order-averaged reports, rather than an average of per-order absolute discrepancies.
paragraphs.zh: 真实主张研究使用 48 条经筛选的 AVeriTeC 开发集主张，在「支持」与「反驳」之间保持平衡，来自 25 个事实核查组织（Schlichtkrull et al. 2023）。 我们在收集任何模型响应之前，选取了带有链接文本证据的独立主张，每个组织最多三条。 每条主张跨越两个初始立场、以 25% 为步长的五个反对等级、缺席/可见的来源证据、原始/否定的措辞、私人/公开的受众，以及两种镜像的同伴顺序。 四个同伴报告 0.2 或 0.8。 该设计包含 7,680 条响应记录；在计算非线性结果之前，先对两种同伴顺序的报告取平均，得到 3,840 个观测值和 1,920 个互补对。 因此，它们的绝对差异是顺序平均后报告的绝对差异，而不是逐顺序绝对差异的平均值。

paragraphs.en: The controlled benchmark contains 24 worlds, four in each of six structural families: exclusive color, binary switch, integer parity, threshold partition, finite-set membership, and strict event order. Every world defines two exhaustive, mutually exclusive outcomes at a fixed referent and time. In half of the worlds the original description is true. Each orientation has a base sentence and one same-polarity paraphrase. The main test describes both outcomes affirmatively (for example, “the token is red” and “the token is blue”); a secondary test replaces the second description with an explicit negation of the first.
paragraphs.zh: 受控基准包含 24 个世界，六个结构族各四个：排他颜色、二元开关、整数奇偶性、阈值划分、有限集合成员关系和严格事件顺序。 每个世界在固定的指称对象和时间上定义两个穷尽且互斥的结果。 在一半的世界中，原始描述为真。 每个取向都有一个基础句和一个同极性改写句。 主测试以肯定方式描述两个结果（例如，「令牌是红色的」和「令牌是蓝色的」）；次要测试将第二个描述替换为对第一个描述的显式否定。

paragraphs.en: Repair uses one placement and compares four arms: the unchanged baseline, the complement reminder, the average of two greedy calls in the same orientation, and symmetrization, which averages each report with the complement of its paired report (Equation 24 ). Baseline, reminder and averaging populations evolve separately in each orientation. Symmetrization keeps one population and derives its complementary display from the same recorded pair. Because repaired states change later requests, every round is generated afresh rather than corrected after the fact.
paragraphs.zh: 修复使用一种放置方式并比较四个分支：未改变的基线、补集提醒、同一朝向下两次贪心调用的平均值，以及对称化——即将每份报告与其配对报告的补集取平均（公式 24）。 基线、提醒和平均种群在每个朝向下分别演化。 对称化只保留一个种群，并从同一记录的配对中推导其互补显示。 由于修复后的状态会改变后续请求，每一轮都是全新生成的，而不是事后修正。

paragraphs.en: Prompt effects are mixed. Rendering Qwen’s evidence as prose reduces its discrepancy but worsens visible Brier loss in the complementary orientation. The complement reminder improves Gemma’s consistency and visible loss, leaves Llama’s visible consistency unchanged while slightly worsening its loss, and increases Qwen’s discrepancy without evidence by about 0.1 0.1 . Reordering evidence items can change reports without adding information. These controls show sensitivity to instructions and presentation but do not identify its cause. Complete results appear in Appendix C.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词效果参差不齐。 将 Qwen 的证据改写为散文形式能缩小其偏差，但在互补方向上会使可见 Brier 损失恶化。 互补提醒提升了 Gemma 的一致性和可见损失；使 Llama 的可见一致性保持不变，同时使其损失略微恶化；并在无证据条件下使 Qwen 的偏差增加约 0.1 0.1 。 重新排列证据条目的顺序可以在不添加信息的情况下改变报告。 这些控制实验表明结果对指令和呈现方式敏感，但并未识别其原因。 完整结果见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: All paired populations start at zero divergence. Figure 4 shows positive final divergence for every model and evidence condition, with different temporal patterns. With visible evidence, Qwen’s divergence stays roughly flat (about 0.23 to 0.28), and some world and placement combinations finish exactly consistent, whereas Llama’s and Gemma’s divergence grows. paragraphs.en: The network sweep and the paired probes measure different properties of the same simulation. The sweep asks how an evidence-targeting contrast depends on execution order; the probes ask how an agent’s report depends on how its information is worded. The sufficiency result in Equation 16 connects them: complement-consistent updates preserve a fully transformed policy comparison. The converse is false, so the two kinds of evidence have to be collected separately. The propagation study shows that wording differences can enter feedback without always being amplified.
paragraphs.zh: 网络扫描与配套探测测量的是同一个模拟的不同属性。 扫描问的是：针对证据的对比如何依赖于执行顺序；探测问的是：智能体的报告如何依赖于其信息的措辞方式。 式16中的充分性结果将二者联系起来：补集一致的更新能保全完全转换后的策略比较。 逆命题不成立，因此这两类证据必须分别收集。 传播研究表明，措辞差异可能进入反馈过程，而不一定会被放大。

paragraphs.en: When generated probabilities become simulation states, a consistency test should transform the complete request: proposition, own probability, ordered peer reports, and fixed evidence. It should be paired with same-polarity paraphrase controls, should separate mean-report effects from variation across draws, and should propagate both orientations under identical execution rules. Evaluating a repair also requires factual loss and call cost alongside consistency. The numbers we report are observed responses; reading them as internal beliefs or as human behavior requires further evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 当生成的概率成为模拟状态时，一致性测试应转换完整的请求：命题、自身概率、有序的同伴报告以及固定证据。 它应与同极性改写对照配对使用，应将平均报告效应与多次抽样间的变异区分开来，并应在相同的执行规则下传播两种取向。 评估修复还需要在一致性之外考虑事实损失和调用成本。 我们报告的数字是观察到的响应；将其解读为内部信念或人类行为还需要进一步的证据。

paragraphs.en: Equivalent complementary descriptions produce incompatible probability reports in the tested agent simulations. The discrepancy appears on states taken from a running simulation and on real fact-checking claims, exceeds matched paraphrase sensitivity in the controlled benchmark, and can persist after reports become later inputs. Symmetrization enforces complementary outputs, but its value under feedback is an empirical question: lower loss averaged over orientations can coexist with higher loss than the better baseline orientation. Simulations that treat generated probabilities as agent states should therefore report consistency and factual performance separately.
paragraphs.zh: 等价的互补描述在被测智能体模拟中产生了不相容的概率报告。 这种差异出现在从运行中的模拟所取的状态上，也出现在真实的事实核查声明上；在受控基准中它超过了匹配改写的敏感度，并且在报告成为后续输入之后仍可能持续存在。 对称化可以强制实现互补输出，但其在反馈条件下的价值是一个经验性问题：在各个方向上平均得到的更低损失，可能与比更好的基线方向更高的损失并存。 因此，将生成的概率视为智能体状态的模拟，应当分别报告一致性与事实性表现。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists the six families. Each world fixes a referent and a time, and its two descriptions are exhaustive and mutually exclusive. Both descriptions of a world concern the same observed fact, so one evidence block verifies either of them. The explicit-negation control keeps the original description and replaces the complementary one with its negation, for example is not red in place of is blue .

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 shows, world by world, how the absolute discrepancy changes when the complementary description is an explicit negation. Without evidence, most changes are below 0.15 in magnitude. With evidence, Qwen shows large changes in both directions in a few worlds, Llama’s remain small, and Gemma’s are mostly negative. Negation therefore leaves the main result intact, and the affirmative descriptions are not systematically easier for the models.

paragraphs.en: All models run in llama.cpp with a 4,096-token context and at most 192 generated tokens. Greedy decoding uses temperature 0, top- p p 1, top- k k 0, min- p p 0 and repetition penalty 1; repeated sampling uses temperature 0.2 with a separate seed per draw. Llama’s chat template inserts the current date, which is fixed to the same value in every compared Llama request. Gemma receives the system instruction and user message as one user turn and is constrained with a JSON schema instead of a grammar. A response is accepted only if it contains exactly one finite number in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and no other field.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型均在 llama.cpp 中运行，上下文长度为 4,096 个 token，最多生成 192 个 token。 贪心解码使用 temperature 0、top- p p 1、top- k k 0、min- p p 0 和重复惩罚 1；重复采样使用 temperature 0.2，且每次抽取使用单独的种子。 Llama 的聊天模板会插入当前日期，在每个被比较的 Llama 请求中，该日期均固定为相同的值。 Gemma 将系统指令和用户消息作为一个用户轮次接收，并使用 JSON 模式而非文法进行约束。 仅当响应在 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 中恰好包含一个有限数字且不含其他字段时，才接受该响应。

paragraphs.en: In the network study, initial probabilities are drawn uniformly from [ 0.2 , 0.8 ] [0.2,0.8] . Degree targeting breaks ties by a seeded shuffle; random targeting samples three agents without replacement. Each agent’s neighbors are shuffled at every update, and response seeds depend on world seed, scenario, round and agent, matched across policies and schedules. Bootstrap intervals resample scenario pairs crossed with world seeds in the network and preserved-state studies, and claims within label in the real-claim study. Peer orders are averaged before any absolute value, loss or flip indicator is computed.
paragraphs.zh: 在网络研究中，初始概率从 [0.2, 0.8] 中均匀抽取。 度数定向通过带种子的洗牌来打破平局；随机定向则不放回地抽取三个智能体。 每个智能体的邻居在每次更新时都会被洗牌，且响应种子取决于世界种子、情境、轮次和智能体，并在不同策略与时间表之间保持一致。 在网络研究和保持状态研究中，自助法区间对情境对与世界种子的交叉组合进行重抽样；在真实声明研究中，则对同一标签内的声明进行重抽样。 在计算任何绝对值、损失或翻转指标之前，先对同伴的排序取平均。

paragraphs.en: In the feedback studies, each agent’s four neighbors on the radius-two ring are sorted by agent index, every round reads the complete previous state, and reports are passed on as recorded, without rounding or smoothing.
paragraphs.zh: 在反馈研究中，每个智能体在半径为二的环上的四个邻居按智能体索引排序，每一轮读取完整的上一轮状态，报告按记录原样传递，不进行四舍五入或平滑处理。
